title.narrative: Nyala Capacity Strengthening and Frontier Capital Learning Lab Program

description.narrative: The Capacity Support Program and the Frontier Capital Learning lab are initiatives to support Nyala Venture catalytic investment facility. The Capacity Support Program will build on and leverage the existing work of CFF with Alternative Local Capital Providers (ALCP) as part of its Early-Stage Capital Provider Network and Frontier Capital Learning Lab.

The overall objective of the Capital Strengthening activities is to provide the LCPs with the necessary support to strengthen their capabilities and operation to attract additional investment capital from institutional investors successfully. The learning activities should achieve showcasing the LCPs as an investable asset class to the DFIs and other investors. The support will be provided through a cost-effective combination of peer-to-peer engagement, access to digital resources, accelerated learning modules and focused coaching and training.
The Frontier Lab will play a critical role in 'demystifying' the SGB ecosystem and driving more capital into the hands of LCPs. 1. To share knowledge and experiences across the ecosystem 2. Gather data for institutional investors on the fund investment thesis and fund management operating models 3. To share information on investment activities form the due diligence process to portfolio construction and investment instruments. 4. Sharing information on the capacity support requirements and delivery support process. 5. Explore the impact and performance of investments in ALCPs 6. Facilitate engagement with LPs and drive capital to ALCPs 7. Facilitate peer learning through facilitating peer to peer interactions to share learning 8. Inform the design of other facilities such as the 2X Ignite 9. Create visibility, promote and advocate for the ALCP Fund Managers
